symptoms: increased thirst, frequent urination, hunger, fatigue, unexplained weight loss, slow-healing sores, blurred vision
causes: problems with insulin production or insulin action
risk_factors: family history, overweight, physical inactivity, and increasing age
prevention: healthy eating, regular physical activity, maintaining a healthy weight, and regular medical checkups
treatment: lifestyle management, blood glucose monitoring, and medicines or insulin as prescribed by a healthcare professional

symptoms: fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, muscle pain
causes: infection with Plasmodium parasites transmitted through infected mosquitoes
risk_factors: travel or residence in areas where malaria transmission occurs
prevention: prevent mosquito bites, use insect repellent, and use mosquito nets in risk areas
treatment: antimalarial medicines prescribed according to the type of malaria and medical guidance

symptoms: high fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pain, nausea, vomiting, rash
causes: infection with dengue virus transmitted through infected mosquitoes
risk_factors: living in or traveling to areas where dengue occurs and exposure to infected mosquitoes
prevention: prevent mosquito bites, remove standing water, and use insect repellent
treatment: supportive care such as fluids and medical monitoring; severe cases require medical attention

symptoms: wheezing, coughing, shortness of breath, chest tightness
causes: airway inflammation and sensitivity to various triggers
risk_factors: allergies, family history, air pollution, tobacco smoke, and respiratory infections
prevention: avoid known triggers, reduce exposure to smoke and pollutants, and follow an asthma action plan
treatment: long-term control medicines and quick-relief medicines as prescribed by a healthcare professional

risk_factors: close contact with infected individuals and weakened immune system
prevention: early detection, appropriate treatment, good ventilation, and reducing exposure to infected individuals
treatment: a combination of antibiotics taken for the prescribed duration under medical supervision

causes: multiple genetic, environmental, and lifestyle factors
risk_factors: age, family history, obesity, high salt intake, and physical inactivity
prevention: healthy diet, regular physical activity, healthy weight, limiting salt, and avoiding tobacco
treatment: lifestyle changes and medicines prescribed by a healthcare professional

symptoms: cough, fever, chills, chest pain, difficulty breathing, fatigue
causes: infection caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi
